features.heroSubtitle: Everything you need to find or list a room — powered by AI, built for migrants.

aiMatching.title: AI Matching
aiMatching.desc: Our intelligent algorithms analyse your preferences, budget, lifestyle, and location to surface the best room matches — so you spend less time searching and more time settling in.

verifiedHosts.title: Verified Hosts
verifiedHosts.desc: Every owner on MigRent goes through identity verification. Look for the trust badge before you enquire — because safety comes first when you're new to a country.

instantBooking.title: Instant Booking
instantBooking.desc: Skip the endless back-and-forth emails. Verified rooms with Instant Booking let you secure your spot with a single click — perfect for arrivals who need certainty fast.

smartFilters.title: Smart Filters
smartFilters.desc: Narrow down thousands of listings with powerful filters — suburb, price range, room type, furnishing, pet policy, transport links, and 20+ more criteria built for real needs.

superhost.title: Superhost Program
superhost.desc: Our best owners earn Superhost status through consistent 5-star reviews, fast response times, and zero cancellations. Superhosts get priority visibility and a gold badge.

support.title: 24/7 Support
support.desc: Moving to a new country is stressful enough. Our multilingual support team is available around the clock via in-app chat to help with any issues — from booking problems to safety concerns.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
